candidates.change_summary: Replace the returned immutable argument index from 0x0 to 0x14 so owner() returns the address stored at the collateral slot instead of the original owner slot.
Return an address-wrapped ERC20 constructed from a different immutable arg offset (0x28 instead of 0x14), changing which stored address is returned.
Return the stored address as a payable address cast to ERC20 by converting the obtained address to uint160 and adding 1 before casting, changing the returned value.
Return the zero address cast as ERC20 instead of the immutable argument address.
Return the owner address (argument at offset 0x0) cast as the debt token, swapping which immutable arg is returned.
Return the collateral address (argument at offset 0x14) cast as the debt token instead of the original debt arg.
Return the immutable arg address but with its low bit cleared (masking address) before casting to ERC20, altering returned address.
Change returned factory address to read from a different immutable argument offset (0x28 instead of 0x3c), causing factory() to return the debt address rather than the factory address.
